# Enclosure source

[Project overview](../README.md) · [Documentation](../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Parametric housings with a keyed seam, heat-set hardware, padded ribbon retention and engraved CAN identification.

![Exploded two-port housing](../preview/2port-exploded.png)

## Edit the design

| Source | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| [parameters.json](parameters.json) | Board sizes, clearances, inserts, screws, clamp and cable assumptions |
| [build.py](build.py) | Both housings, fit coupons, assembly references and collision evidence |
| [markings.py](markings.py) | One vector layout for the engraved lid and SVG proof |
| [hardware_models.py](hardware_models.py) | Drawing-based female DE9, backshell and thumbscrew envelopes |

Run `.venv/bin/python cad/build.py` from the repository root after exporting the latest PCB STEP. Follow with mechanical checks, STEP readback renders and 3MF/viewer regeneration; see the [tools guide](../tools/README.md).

KiCad STEP is placed by a proper 180° rotation, preserving connector handedness. Dimensions are millimeters. Printable STL/3MF files are bed-oriented; STEP files retain assembly coordinates. [Design and fit assumptions](../docs/enclosure.md).
